title: What's new in SCM: Migrate Italian Subcontracting
summary: This session is for Italian customers and partners. It explains how to move from the old Italian subcontracting functionality to the new global Subcontracting app, which replaces it. The presenter walks through a Contoso Italy company: the legacy toggle in Manufacturing Setup, the pre-check, cleaning up open transfer and purchase documents with work in progress items, installing the apps, and running the migration. He then shows what changes afterwards (fields, pages, views, prices) and lists the requirements and what data gets migrated. Migration can now run in production, based on customer and partner feedback.

features.name: New Subcontracting app replaces Italian legacy subcontracting
features.description: The existing Italian subcontracting functionality is discontinued and replaced by the Subcontracting app, which is available globally and in Italy. It covers the Italian features and more, with one significant implementation difference around work in progress items.
features.status_evidence_quote: With new subcontracting app available globally and in Italy
caveats: One significant implementation difference around work in progress items makes a migration step necessary

features.name: Legacy subcontracting toggle in Manufacturing Setup
features.description: An Italy-only field in Manufacturing Setup indicates that legacy subcontracting is on. In a newly provisioned environment it is off by default and the new app is installed; in an upgraded environment it is on and the new app is not installed.
caveats: To go back to legacy you must uninstall the subcontracting app first

features.name: Legacy subcontracting pre-check
features.description: A new action checks for open transfer orders and purchase orders with work in progress items before legacy subcontracting is disabled. The same checks run anyway when you disable it, so skipping the pre-check does not bypass them.
caveats: Open documents with work in progress items must be handled first: post, delete or recreate them
Subcontracting orders without work in progress lines can stay as they are
prerequisites: No open transfer orders or purchase orders with work in progress items

features.name: Install Subcontracting app from Manufacturing Setup
features.description: The Subcontracting app can be installed directly from Manufacturing Setup when you try to disable legacy subcontracting. The system checks whether migration is needed and, if there is no legacy data, only the new app is installed with no migration.
caveats: Installing the app returns you to the role center
The assisted setup was skipped in the demo because it is covered in a different session
Installing the app alone does not trigger the migration

features.name: Italian Subcontracting Migration app
features.description: A separate app that migrates legacy Italian subcontracting data to the new Subcontracting app. It is not listed on AppSource and is installed from the tenant through Manufacturing Setup, and the system proposes it only when migration is needed. Migration now works in production environments after improvements based on Italian customer and partner feedback.
features.status_evidence_quote: Previously, when we just released it, we make sure that migration is not possible
caveats: Work in progress items, purchase and transfer documents must be handled up front
prerequisites: Italian Subcontracting Migration app installed from the tenant

features.name: Run migration by disabling legacy subcontracting
features.description: The action Legacy subcontracting, then Disable legacy subcontracting, runs the data migration and restarts the session. It switches application areas, turning off the legacy area and turning on the Subcontracting area. The system blocks activating the toggle if legacy data exists and has not been migrated.
caveats: Session restarts because application areas are reactivated
Toggle cannot be activated without migration if legacy data exists
prerequisites: Open work in progress documents cleaned up

features.name: Subcontracting views on purchase and transfer orders
features.description: After migration the dedicated legacy subcontracting order and transfer order pages are gone. Migrated documents appear in the normal purchase order and transfer order lists, with a view to show only subcontracting documents.
caveats: Legacy subcontracting fields are no longer shown, only the new app fields
Dedicated legacy pages are no longer available

features.name: Migrated vendor fields and subcontracting prices
features.description: Vendor subcontracting fields such as subcontractor and subcontracting location code are migrated, and the link to the work center stays. Subcontracting prices look the same but now live in the new table.
caveats: Minor fields are mentioned as migrated here and there
